hero_revision.scope: Landing composition, hero artwork, standalone unused logo SVG. Prior full-route suites above describe the initial build.
hero_revision.automated_a11y: Zero reported violations at inspected desktop and mobile landing sizes; gradient contrast checks remain incomplete.
hero_revision.motion: Offscreen scene paused; global pause disabled road animation; restored enabled state.
hero_revision.logo: Docs/assets/orix-logo-reference.svg; outlined paths; no image/font links; not referenced by the site.

favicon_revision.change: Supplied ORIX symbol replaces static and timed autorickshaw favicons; tab titles remain dynamic.

minimal_hero_revision.scope: Frontend visual review only. Full route sweep preceded final hero/chat refinements; affected routes rechecked afterward.
